payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test never pinned what list _guarded_blockers is called with. Through the public RebutResult the two forms are equal, since a filtered-out lens never produces a verdict to check the guard against, so the finding is real only as an internal contract, not a black-box one. I added a spy on rebut._guarded_blockers that records the length of its first argument and asserted it equals the full blocker count in every case, which fails when the call site filters that list by unreviewed first.
